Lasso Regression (ℓ₁ Regularization) — Bias Correction of Numerical Prediction Model Temperature Forecast

Target: Next_Tmax (deg C) · Run UTC: 2026-11-24T18:42:26.404961+00:00

1. Dataset and Task Description

Summer next-day maximum temperature forecasts from Korea Meteorological Administration LDAPS across 25 Seoul weather stations (2013-2017).

  • Two trailing summary rows with missing Date/station (min/max rows in raw UCI CSV) and 27 rows with missing target 'Next_Tmax' are dropped prior to splitting.
  • 'Next_Tmin' is excluded as a co-target not available at prediction time; 'station' is excluded because station geography is captured by lat/lon/DEM/Slope.
  • Predictor missing values (~70-75 rows) are median-imputed using training-fold statistics only.
  • Chronological date-level 80/20 split ensures all stations on a given date appear together with zero same-day or future leakage.

3. Mathematical Methodology

Adds an \(\ell_1\) penalty on standardized slopes (leaving \(\beta_0\) unpenalized) to perform continuous shrinkage and automatic variable selection via coordinate-wise soft-thresholding.

$$\min_{\beta_0 \in \mathbb{R},\, \boldsymbol{\beta} \in \mathbb{R}^p} \frac{1}{2n}\|\mathbf{y} - \beta_0\mathbf{1} - \tilde{\mathbf{X}}\boldsymbol{\beta}\|_2^2 + \alpha\|\boldsymbol{\beta}\|_1, \qquad \hat{\beta}_j = \mathcal{S}\!\left(\frac{1}{n}\tilde{\mathbf{x}}_j^\top \mathbf{r}^{(-j)}, \alpha\right) \quad \left(\lambda \equiv \alpha \ge 0,\ \frac{1}{n}\|\tilde{\mathbf{x}}_j\|_2^2 = 1\right)$$

Implementation Note: min_{beta0, beta} (1 / (2*n)) * ||y - beta0 - X*beta||_2^2 + alpha * ||beta||_1 (intercept beta0 unpenalized)
CV-Selected Hyperparameter: \(\alpha^* = 0.290505\) (\(\lambda \equiv \alpha\)) over 60 grid points in \([0.0002584, 2.584]\).

7. Limitations and Conclusions

Facts & Interpretations

  • [Computed Fact] Held-out test performance (\(n_{\mathrm{test}} = 1538\)): \(R^2 = 0.6837\), \(\mathrm{RMSE} = 1.77\) deg C (Train \(R^2 = 0.7374\), Train \(\mathrm{RMSE} = 1.595\) deg C).
  • [Computed Fact] Largest standardized coefficients by magnitude: LDAPS_Tmax_lapse (+1.809), Present_Tmax (+0.5625), LDAPS_WS (-0.1498).
  • [Computed Fact] DateGroupedTimeSeriesSplit(5) selected \(\alpha^* = 0.2905\) (CV RMSE = 1.85 deg C, CV \(R^2 = 0.5529\)), converging in 22 coordinate-descent iterations.
  • [Interpretation] Soft-thresholding retained \(|A(\alpha^*)| = 7\) of \(p = 21\) predictors and eliminated 14 (66.7% sparse), reducing the \(\ell_1\) norm from 5.768 (OLS) to 2.797 (ratio = 0.4850).
  • [Computed Fact] Eliminated predictors include LDAPS_RHmin, LDAPS_RHmax, LDAPS_Tmin_lapse, LDAPS_LH, LDAPS_CC2 (max \(|r|\) with a retained predictor = 0.776).

Assumptions & Limitations

  • [Selection Instability Under Collinearity] 8 predictor(s) varied in selection across CV folds (e.g., LDAPS_CC4 (0.60), LDAPS_WS (0.40), LDAPS_CC3 (0.40), Present_Tmin (0.20)), because \(\ell_1\) KKT pinning selects one representative among correlated features.
  • [Temporal Structure] Static linear predictors omit explicit lag or seasonal terms across the chronological train-to-test boundary.
  • [Linearity Assumption] Linear models assume additive linear relationships between standardized predictors and conditional target expectation.
